profile.hero_desc: HAQ Hanoi Joint Stock Company is a leading manufacturer and distributor of packaged processed foods in Vietnam. We combine local agricultural produce with closed convection clean-drying technology to deliver superior safety standards and elevate Vietnamese culinary heritage.
profile.sec1_title: HAQ FOOD HANOI JOINT STOCK COMPANY
profile.sec1_desc: Established in 2021 in Hanoi, HAQ Hanoi Joint Stock Company specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of packaged processed foods. The company masters closed convection drying technology, developing premium crispy rice paper snacks, traditional baked goods, and dried agricultural products for domestic retail chains and international export markets.

profile.fact_scope_val: Manufacturing, deep processing and preserving packaged foods: Premium crispy rice paper snacks (HOKI), Almond baked snacks, Coconut milk biscuits, Mung bean cakes, and Dried agricultural goods.
profile.fact_dist_val: Modern retail chains (WinMart, Circle K, GS25, Bach Hoa Xanh, K-Market...), nationwide wholesale networks, and exports to South Korea and Taiwan.
profile.fact_coop_val: Wholesale supply, Customized manufacturing (OEM/ODM), Private Label contract manufacturing.
profile.photo_caption: HAQ FOOD Production Facility in Hanoi: Closed-loop quality control from raw material screening and hygienic convection drying to sterilized aluminum barrier packaging.
profile.coop_box_desc: Direct consultation for wholesale pricing, OEM contracts, and sample requests.

core_caps.title: Closed Convection Drying
core_caps.desc: Applies circulating hot-air drying with precision temperature and humidity control, ensuring crispness without residual frying oil.

core_caps.title: Vietnamese Local Agriculture
core_caps.desc: Partners directly with clean Vietnamese agricultural farms with full origin traceability, conducting regular microbiological checks.

core_caps.title: Flexible OEM / ODM Services
core_caps.desc: Supports retail chains and international partners with recipe R&D, sampling, custom packaging design, and full regulatory documentation.

profile.sec2_desc_1: We believe genuine quality begins with honest ingredients, rigorous processes, and responsible artisans. HAQ FOOD continually innovates to deliver convenient, safe, and authentically Vietnamese flavors.
profile.sec2_desc_2: We build an integrated value chain spanning from carefully selected fresh farm produce to clean convection drying and sterile packaging, serving both consumer markets and global exports.
profile.sec2_photo_title: Harmonizing Local Produce with Modern Drying Tech
profile.sec3_desc: Comprehensive manufacturing capabilities from preparation and thermal processing to crispy drying and export-grade packaging.
profile.sec3_kcs_desc: The HAQ FOOD facility is equipped with synchronized convection drying lines, sterile blending cleanrooms, and standardized storage warehouses.

sec3_kcs_points.title: Absolute Food Safety & Hygiene
sec3_kcs_points.desc: Strict protocols from cleanroom garments to sterile processing environments.

sec3_kcs_points.title: High Batch Consistency
sec3_kcs_points.desc: Automated thermal regulation ensures uniform taste, texture, and crispness across every production run.

sec3_kcs_points.title: Independent QC Inspections
sec3_kcs_points.desc: Every dispatch undergoes independent sensory and microbiological testing before leaving the warehouse.

profile.sec4_desc: Continuous operating line strictly monitoring thermal humidity and food safety from raw intake to final packaged dispatch.
profile.sec6_desc: HAQ FOOD actively expands across international markets, bringing rich Vietnamese agricultural flavors to global retail partners and consumers.
profile.sec7_desc: Long-term commitments to consumers, B2B partners, workforce welfare, and Vietnamese sustainable agriculture.
profile.cta_desc: HAQ FOOD is ready to partner with distributors, supermarket chains, and global importers through flexible policies, consistent quality, and reliable supply capacity.
